alex_infra: quick async standup — yesterday: drained 2 nodes in us-west for kernel patch, saw queue spike ~14:03 and a couple of long tail requests. Blocker: eu-west GPU quota change still pending with cloud support (request 12345-zz). Today: prepare fallback routing + follow up on quota, plan manual 2-node scale if needed.

maria_sre: can you paste the cloud case link/ID? I can escalate and loop legal if they ask for usage docs.

alex_infra: case: 12345-zz (support ticket). link: https://cloud.support/req/12345-zz — they asked for utilization screenshots, attached in the case. also seeing increased preemptible evictions in ams this morning.

kevin_prodeng: @maria_sre thanks — if eu-west lags we should failover low-priority queues to us-east. i'll draft a tiny router change to prefer region with spare headroom.

jenna_oncall: oncall note: if eu-west stays constrained i'll enable burst routing to us-east at ~11:30 PT to avoid latency SLO breaches. ping me before you flip.

capacity-bot: [alert] Autoscale: 3/40 GPU nodes in us-west >85% CPU for 12m. Recent scale events: manual_scale +1 at 14:12.

alex_infra: plan: 1) escalate quota (maria), 2) enable burst to us-east as fallback (jenna), 3) cancel one preemptible batch job, 4) manual scale +2 if needed. running manual create command to validate images: ```gcloud compute instances create rwd-gpu-test-02 --zone=us-east1-b --accelerator=type=nvidia-t4,count=1 --machine-type=n1-standard-8 --image-family=redwood-gpu-image --quiet```

maria_sre: escalated to P1 with support lead, they estimate 4-6h to approve. also opened a temporary regional increase in us-east as contingency.

kevin_prodeng: i'll open PR for the router fallback (router/region-fallback) and tag @alex_infra for review. PR ref: #2345. small change, can be hotfixed.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: capacity-safety-toggle v1.3.4 to prod (canary pass).

jenna_oncall: :thumbsup: i'll stand by for the flip. alex, if you want me to run the manual scale, reply with "go" and i'll execute.

alex_infra: thanks all — i'll cancel the preemptible batch now and post an update in this thread after the quota reply or after manual scale. estimated close: EOD.
